HEADLINE: We wish to inform you that the Board of Directors ('Board') of Leo Dryfruits and Spices Trading Limited (the 'Company'), at its meeting held today i.e., Friday, November 13, 2026, inter-alia, ....
MORE:
We wish to inform you that the Board of Directors ('Board') of Leo Dryfruits and Spices Trading Limited (the 'Company'), at its meeting held today i.e., Friday, November 13, 2026, inter-alia, considered and approved the following matters: 

1. Approved Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results of the company for the half year on September 30, 2026 

2. Approved in principle the proposal to establish two subsidiaries in the United Arab Emirates (UAE), with the proposed locations being Dubai Mainland and Jebel Ali Free Zone (JAFZA), or any other suitable jurisdiction / free zone within the UAE, as may be considered appropriate by the Company based on operational convenience and business requirements. 

Detailed disclosure is provided in Annexure A.
NEWSSUB: Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of Board Meeting Held On Friday, November 13, 2026
